title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378L (Vesting of undertaking in Producer Company)

content.overview: On the date of transformation: (1) all properties and assets of the inter-State co-operative society vest in the Producer Company; (2) all rights, debts, liabilities, interests, privileges and obligations stand transferred to the Producer Company; (3) debts, liabilities, obligations, contracts and matters engaged to be done by, with or for the society are deemed done by, with or for the Producer Company; (4) sums due to the society are deemed due to the Producer Company; (5) organisations managed by the society continue under the Producer Company as circumstances require; and (6) organisations receiving assistance from the society may continue to receive it from the Producer Company as the company deems fit.
content.glance: Comprehensive statutory vesting of assets, liabilities, contracts and continuing management/assistance on transformation.
content.study: Section 378L effects a clean statutory succession from the inter-State co-operative society to the Producer Company on the date of transformation. It avoids the need for individual transfers of each asset, liability or contract. Management of organisations previously managed by the society, and financial, managerial or technical assistance previously given, may continue under the Producer Company.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: On transformation, properties, assets, rights, debts, liabilities, contracts and related interests of the inter-State co-operative society vest in or continue under the Producer Company as provided in s. 378L(1)–(6).

provisions.title: Vesting of undertaking in Producer Company

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378L
examples.body: Land, contracts and outstanding receivables of the inter-State co-operative society become those of the Producer Company on the date of transformation without separate conveyance.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378L?
hypotheticals.analysis: It provides for automatic vesting and continuation of the undertaking of the inter-State co-operative society in the Producer Company on the date of transformation.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming individual conveyances are still required for each asset.
misconceptions.correction: s. 378L effects statutory vesting; separate transfers are not required for the items it covers.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378L be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the date of transformation. II. Apply the six vesting/continuation rules. III. Conclude.
